review_scope: official evidence versus the complete detector claim
entailed_claims: Random values are used for cryptographic keys, nonces, and salts.
When a cryptographic implementation generates random values, a validated random-number generator is required.
not_exactly_entailed_claims: Every listed C library function is categorically forbidden in every context.
Operating-system CSPRNG APIs listed by the author are KCMVP-approved substitutes.
The mere lexical occurrence of rand, srand, random, drand48, clock, or time proves cryptographic use.

required: reachable def-use from a weak generator result to an audited cryptographic key, IV, nonce, salt, or signature-nonce sink
dead-code, test-vector, KAT, benchmark, logging, and non-cryptographic-use exclusions
